My visit wasn't for the best reasons; unfortunately, we did all the exams, but I lost my kitten. However, the veterinarians and staff were all impeccable in dealing with our grief. They were very humane, giving us all the support and affection, and our kitten passed away peacefully 🙏
I recommend this clinic.

Terrible!! They don't answer the phone. Not even for emergencies. I went there after calling with an emergency and nobody answered, and there was nobody at reception. Previously, in a Friday emergency, they told me they would only see my cat on Monday, who has been followed there since he was a kitten. He's 14 years old now. And before that, on another occasion, he wasn't seen in an urgent situation either. After these three incidents, I decided I should post this review.
